correctness.rationale: The polynomial identity Delta_1 P=P' is proved termwise, the two-element fibres by a finite-field gcd, and the two lifted difference invariances by Taylor expansion modulo four. Distinct derivative residues prevent merging of different paired cosets. Every possible domain element is accounted for, giving exactly q/2 outputs with 2q preimages each, independently of all lift coefficients. Reproducible GR(4,5) enumeration checked all 32 residue-one unit directions for three lifts, and independent binary-polynomial symbolic identities for m<=11; finite checks are supplements to the universal proof.
